name: xtract-replies
description: Extract replies from X.com posts and export as CSV/HTML. Ideal for researchers and journalists.

scripts.pack: npm run sync-version && rm -f xtract-replies-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -r xtract-replies-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json package.json background.js main.js popup.html popup.js PRIVACY.md LICENSE README.md assets -x '*.DS_Store' -x 'assets/.DS_Store'
